summary_en: FY2026/4 final dividend raised ¥20/share to ¥100/share from prior guidance of ¥80/share. Net income forecast increased 25.9% to ¥17.0B, attributed to higher-priced prescriptions in pharmacy business and PMI progress from Sakura Pharmacy Group acquisition (August 2025).
title_en: Notice regarding revision of earnings forecast (upward revision) and revision of final dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: On June 1, 2026, AIN Holdings announced an upward revision to its FY2026/4 (year ending April 30, 2026) earnings forecast and an increase to the final dividend guidance. Parent company net income is now forecast at ¥17.0 billion, a 25.9% increase from the prior September 2025 guidance of ¥13.5 billion. The company attributes the improvement to strong prescription pricing trends in its pharmacy business (driven by higher-value drug prescriptions) and smooth post-acquisition integration (PMI) of the Sakura Pharmacy Group, which joined the group on August 1, 2025. Additionally, the forecast reflects increased expected tax benefits. In accordance with its shareholder return policy, the company increased the final dividend (year-end) from the previously guided ¥80/share to ¥100/share, a ¥20/share increase. The interim dividend (second quarter) remains at ¥80/share, resulting in a total annual dividend of ¥180/share for FY2026/4 compared to ¥160/share in the prior year.
